facts.function: interlocking strips assembled into a ~13 ft chain garland
facts.form: flat packed unassembled kit of notched strips in polybag

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 9505 covers festive, carnival or other entertainment articles; chapter 95 note 1 does not exclude flimsy paper party decorations
GRI 2(a): unassembled strips have the essential character of the finished garland
GRI 6: 9505.90 Other; 9505.90.40 paper spirals or streamers, party favors

rejected_alternatives.reason: other paper articles; specific festive heading 9505 governs flimsy single-use party decorations
not a magic trick or other festive article outside the paper streamer/party favor provision

classification.rationale: Flimsy single-use paper garland sold as a party decoration is a festive article of heading 9505; CROSS garland rulings consistently place such party decorations in 9505.90.40 (N334971 in force).
